summary: Iteration 104: UI/UX fixes for Chutex Care health app - Testing completed. Most features passed, one filtering bug found.

ui_bugs.issue: Bedtime recommendation ('Coucher conseille') not displayed because frontend filters sleep items when sleep_quality=0 and sleep_duration_min=0. Backend returns correct data with precise time '22:34'.

action_items: FIX: Frontend health.tsx line 150 - The sleep item filter should NOT exclude bedtime recommendations. Change the condition to always show sleep items that are 'conseil' status, even when sleep_quality=0

VERIFIED: Nora analysis section visible on glycemia page

VERIFIED: Recovery section shows percentage (50%) with label (Moyenne) and progress bar
VERIFIED: Backend bedtime recommendation uses precise time (22:34) not round numbers

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 104: Frontend filtering bug - The sleep/bedtime item is not shown in 'Objectifs journaliers' because the filter at line 150 excludes it when sleep_quality=0.
